ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 75% high-intensity (white) pixels and 25% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous fields covering the majority of both lobes. A central black pigmentation zone bifurcates upwards from the peduncle. A thin, irregular black border follows the trailing edge. Two isolated circular black pigment blobs are located in the distal quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad U-shaped depression with an estimated interior pixel angle of 135 degrees and a moderate vertical depth relative to the lobe crests.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 2 to 7 pixels along the entire trailing boundary. A distinct irregular defect/excision is present at the terminal point of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curves extending from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp, slightly recurved points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized, textured white/grey cluster of high-contrast pixels on the far right fluke tip. Scattered small white punctate spots on the central black pigmentation of the peduncle.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single distinct dark diagonal linear mark (~30 pixels) on the distal right lobe. Subtle horizontal linear disruptions on the left lobe near the leading edge boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged tissue defect on the upper right tip associated with white calcified clusters. Minor nicks along the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A pair of vertically aligned, isolated circular black pigment spots positioned in the white field of the right lobe distal to the center.
